name: ralph-helper
description: Plan-aware phase runner: splits a plan into tested phases, runs each in a fresh subagent, gates on the test exit code, commits and tags every phase on its own branch, rolls back failed attempts, and learns per project via Obsidian memory + graphify search.

notesDir.title: Notes folder
notesDir.description: Absolute path to an Obsidian folder holding one folder per project (e.g. ~/.obsidian/MyVault/Projects). Ralph Learnings and run session notes go to <notesDir>/<project>/. Empty keeps learnings in logs/<plan>/learnings.json and graphify only.
